entry.title: πToniC 1.1.2
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.1.2 - **MicroTonic kit import**: new **IMPORT KIT** button at the bottom left of the MIXER page. It opens the file browser on `.mtpreset` files (MicroTonicPresetV3). The eight sounds replace banks A and B of the eight voices; all voices switch to SYNTH, bank A, no mute or solo; REVERB / DELAY sends are set to 0. Effect settings and loaded samples are kept. entry.title: πToniC 1.0.4
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.0.4 - **Installation follows Akai's SDK rule**: each release is a plugin folder to copy into `VST2 Plugins` (Gen1 ARM32 and Gen2 ARM64 ZIPs). No installer script, no `Synths` folder, no MPC.settings registration. entry.title: πToniC 1.0.3
entry.summary: # πToniC 1.0.3 A Microtonic-inspired drum machine. πToniC features 8 independent drum voices, each combining filtered noise with a morphing oscillator or WAV sample playback. Its sound engine includes pitch modulation, amplitude envelopes, drive, EQ and individual voice controls.
